description: Structure-based test of whether the human VOC paralogs GLOD5, GLO1, MCEE and HPD carry the GLOD4 His8/Glu70 metal site: superpose each AlphaFold model onto PDB 9CSJ chain A, transfer the GLOD4 zinc position, and list the residues that land in its coordination shell. This answers the paralog-scope ambiguity left open by PMID 41628334, which attributes nitration to "GLOD4 and other structurally related proteins" without naming them.
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

T3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
    'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
    'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}

def parse(txt):
    out=[]
    for L in txt.split("\n"):
        if L.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and len(L)>54 and L[16] in " A":
            el=(L[76:78].strip() or L[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
            out.append(dict(rec=L[:6].strip(),name=L[12:16].strip(),resn=L[17:20].strip(),
                            chain=L[21],resi=int(L[22:26]),el=el,
                            xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]),
                            b=float(L[60:66] or 0)))
    return out

def ca(atoms, chain=None):
    s=[a for a in atoms if a['name']=='CA' and a['resn'] in T3 and (chain is None or a['chain']==chain)]
    s.sort(key=lambda a:a['resi'])
    return s

def kabsch(P,Q):
    cP,cQ=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-cP).T@(Q-cQ); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R, cQ-R@cP

def nw(S,gap=-0.6):
    """vectorised linear-gap Needleman-Wunsch; returns aligned index pairs"""
    n,m=S.shape; NEG=-1e9
    F=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); F[0,0]=0.0
    F[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1); F[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1)
    jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        G=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        G[1:]=np.maximum(F[i-1,:m]+S[i-1,:], F[i-1,1:]+gap); G[0]=F[i-1,0]+gap
        H=G-gap*jj
        F[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(H)+gap*jj
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-7: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j]+gap))<1e-7: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]

def tmalign(Aca,Bca,niter=20):
    """TM-align style iterative superposition of A onto B. Returns (R,t,pairs,tm,rmsd)."""
    A=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in Aca]); B=np.array([b['xyz'] for b in Bca])
    n,m=len(A),len(B); L=min(n,m)
    d0=max(0.5, 1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8)
    best=(None,None,[],-1,None)
    seeds=[]
    for Lf in (L, L//2, L//4, 8):
        if Lf<5: continue
        for off in range(-(m-Lf), n-Lf+1, max(1,(n+m)//20)):
            i0=max(0,off); j0=max(0,-off); ln=min(n-i0,m-j0,Lf)
            if ln>=5: seeds.append((i0,j0,ln))
    for (i0,j0,ln) in seeds:
        P=A[i0:i0+ln]; Q=B[j0:j0+ln]
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
        cur=[(i0+k,j0+k) for k in range(ln)]
        for _ in range(niter):
            At=(R@A.T).T+t
            D=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-B[None,:,:],axis=2)
            S=1.0/(1.0+(D/d0)**2)
            pairs=nw(S)
            if len(pairs)<5: break
            idx=np.array(pairs)
            sel=np.linalg.norm(At[idx[:,0]]-B[idx[:,1]],axis=1)<max(4.5,d0+2)
            use=idx[sel] if sel.sum()>=5 else idx
            R,t=kabsch(A[use[:,0]],B[use[:,1]])
            if pairs==cur: break
            cur=pairs
        At=(R@A.T).T+t
        idx=np.array(cur)
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[idx[:,0]]-B[idx[:,1]],axis=1)
        tm=(1.0/(1.0+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/L
        if tm>best[3]:
            best=(R,t,cur,tm,float(np.sqrt((d**2).mean())))
    return best

# ---------- reference: GLOD4 crystal, chain A, and its VOC zinc ----------
A9=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9CSJ.pdb",timeout=180).text)
A9A=[a for a in A9 if a['chain']=='A']
zn=[a for a in A9A if a['el']=='ZN']
def nprot(z,atoms):
    return sum(1 for a in atoms if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['el'] in ('N','O')
               and np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-z['xyz'])<=2.6)
voczn=[z for z in zn if nprot(z,A9A)>=2][0]
B=ca(A9A)
print("reference 9CSJ:A  CA =",len(B),"  VOC Zn at",np.round(voczn['xyz'],2))

# ---------- paralogs ----------
PARA=[("GLOD4","Q9HC38","self control, AlphaFold model"),
      ("GLOD5","A6NK44","closest paralog, 160 aa, single VOC module"),
      ("GLO1","Q04760","glyoxalase I, catalytic Zn reference"),
      ("MCEE","Q96PE7","methylmalonyl-CoA epimerase"),
      ("HPD","P32754","4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase")]

res=[]
for sym,acc,note in PARA:
    u=f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb"
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=180)
    if r.status_code!=200:
        print(f"{sym} ({acc}): AlphaFold v6 fetch failed, HTTP {r.status_code}; not analysed")
        continue
    Ac=parse(r.text); A=ca(Ac)
    R,t,pairs,tm,rmsd=tmalign(A,B)
    # transfer the GLOD4 zinc into the paralog frame: move paralog onto GLOD4, then
    # measure paralog atoms (all, superposed) against the zinc position
    allat=[a for a in Ac if a['rec']=='ATOM']
    X=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in allat]); Xt=(R@X.T).T+t
    d=np.linalg.norm(Xt-voczn['xyz'],axis=1)
    # collect side-chain N/O/S donors within 6 A, one entry per residue (closest donor)
    shell={}
    for k,a in enumerate(allat):
        if a['el'] not in ('N','O','S'): continue
        if a['name'] in ('N','O'):   # backbone, keep but flag
            tag='bb'
        else:
            tag='sc'
        if d[k]<=6.0:
            key=(a['resi'],a['resn'])
            if key not in shell or d[k]<shell[key][0]:
                shell[key]=(float(d[k]),a['name'],tag)
    sh=sorted([(v[0],f"{T3.get(k[1],'X')}{k[0]}:{v[1]}",v[2]) for k,v in shell.items()])
    plddt=float(np.mean([a['b'] for a in A]))
    res.append(dict(sym=sym,acc=acc,n=len(A),tm=tm,rmsd=rmsd,npair=len(pairs),shell=sh,plddt=plddt))
    print(f"\n=== {sym} ({acc}, {len(A)} aa, mean pLDDT {plddt:.1f}) vs 9CSJ:A ===")
    print(f"    TM-score {tm:.3f}, {len(pairs)} aligned CA, RMSD {rmsd:.2f} A   [{note}]")
    print(f"    residues with N/O/S within 6 A of the transferred GLOD4 zinc:")
    for dd,nm,tag in sh[:10]:
        print(f"       {nm:<14} {dd:5.2f} A  ({tag})")
    if not sh: print("       none")

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
syms=[r['sym'] for r in res]
ax[0].bar(range(len(res)),[r['tm'] for r in res],color=['#1f6fb4']+['#937860']*(len(res)-1))
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(res))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(syms)
ax[0].set_ylabel("TM-score vs GLOD4 9CSJ chain A"); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1)
ax[0].axhline(0.5,color='k',ls='--',lw=1)
ax[0].text(len(res)-0.5,0.52,"TM 0.5, same fold",ha='right',fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_title("Global fold similarity of human VOC paralogs to GLOD4",fontsize=10)
for i,r in enumerate(res): ax[0].text(i,r['tm']+0.02,f"{r['tm']:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)

ax[1].set_title("Residues at the transferred GLOD4 zinc position",fontsize=10)
for i,r in enumerate(res):
    for dd,nm,tag in r['shell'][:6]:
        resl=nm.split(':')[0][0]
        c={'H':'#1f6fb4','E':'#c44e52','C':'#8172b3','D':'#c44e52','K':'#55a868',
           'R':'#55a868','Q':'#dd8452'}.get(resl,'#999999')
        ax[1].scatter(dd,i,color=c,s=55,zorder=3,edgecolor='k',linewidth=0.3)
        ax[1].annotate(nm.split(':')[0],(dd,i),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,8),
                       ha='center',fontsize=6.5)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(res))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(syms)
ax[1].set_xlabel("distance of closest N/O/S donor to the transferred zinc ($\\AA$)")
ax[1].set_xlim(1,6.4); ax[1].set_ylim(-0.6,len(res)-0.2)
ax[1].axvspan(1.9,2.4,color='grey',alpha=0.15,zorder=0)
ax[1].text(0.015,0.04,"grey band = direct coordination distance.  AlphaFold models are apo,\n"
                      "so donors are displaced outward; residue identity is the readout.",
           transform=ax[1].transAxes,fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

import pandas as pd
tab=pd.DataFrame([dict(symbol=r['sym'],accession=r['acc'],length=r['n'],mean_pLDDT=round(r['plddt'],1),
                       TM_score=round(r['tm'],3),aligned_CA=r['npair'],RMSD_A=round(r['rmsd'],2),
                       zinc_site_residues="; ".join(f"{n}={d:.2f}" for d,n,t in r['shell'][:6]))
                  for r in res])
print("\n",tab.to_string(index=False))
tab.to_csv("glod4_paralog_metal_site.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote glod4_paralog_metal_site.csv")
